title: Corrupted
body:
Corrupted is a general tree type that appears after a tree being hit by Mysterious Mushroom's projectile. Cactus, Acacia and Deadwood have corrupted variants while any other wood types will become regular Corrupted. Players often seen them hitting Mushrooms and thought Corrupted must only be spawned by Mushrooms.

Corrupted has a dark purple brown-ish color outside and dark messy purple color inside. All trees being made Corrupted has same properties. Big tree or small all takes 1 hit from the projectile to be converted into Corrupted. Corrupted state convert the tree's bark color and inside as well as not changing any sizing, meshes (like Mushroom cap) begone, union (like most trees complex leaves) become a solid 1 block purple leaf based on model's shape.

Corrupted sells for 1$ per stud, and corrupted variants sell for half the value of their normal counterparts.
